resources.string: Drawings: put one in the trash, or go back to an older version
Versions, newest first: tap one to make it the newest again
Trash: tap one to put it back. Hold the bin with two fingers to empty it for good
Google backup: %1$s MB of the 25 MB it keeps for this app.
Google backup nearly full: %1$s MB of 25 MB. Over 25 MB nothing is backed up at all. Drawings in the trash are not backed up: put old ones there.
Google backup is over its 25 MB (%1$s MB): nothing is being backed up. Drawings in the trash are not backed up: put old ones there.
